feature_contract.goal: Render 4:3 main-menu letterbox bars on landscape and portrait R84 source/mirror geometries without clipping or covering centered menu content, preserving F11 and gameplay drawing state.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original 4:3 front-end menu and optional UILetterboxing=2 in gameplay only; no game viewport/projection, stereo, SkyGlow, world, FFB, timers or DX11/DXVK owner change.
trace_stages: Original UI matrix now contains 640x480 inside portrait source extent; native overlay previously returned with no bars when width <= height*4/3.
D3DEndScene draws two black triangle strips from cached D3DPOOL_DEFAULT vertex geometry; original full viewport/state restoration remains unchanged.
Compute side strips for landscape and top/bottom strips for portrait/square while keeping existing menu source extent and R84/host image ownership.
subcomponents: Implement four aspect layout and bounded per-orientation black bar geometry (native 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, portrait).
Keep existing D3D9/Ex vertex buffer Reset/reallocation semantics, fixed-function state, viewport/scissor, F11 presentation and game render side effects unchanged.
Compile deterministic actual-header positive/negative source/geometry regressions and run exact-SHA Windows Game/Host/Package, Domain and impacted Source gates.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Portrait/square source preserves centered menu with black top and bottom strips, while 16:9 and 21:9 continue to draw their original left/right rails.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Native menu/F11/desktop and D3D9Ex Reset and failed buffer allocation
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: No bars for 4:3; invalid source rejects vertex geometry; recover/reallocate on source/device switch; preserve prior scene state and overlay.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 x86 game, R26_SAFE rollback, x64 OpenXR host and package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Validation-bearing exact SHA passes Active Game/Host/Package + Domain and affected Full Source Impact, HMD separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: CreateLetterboxVertex returned early for any sourceWidth <= sourceHeight*(4/3) and cached no vertex buffer; portrait XR source gets UI centering in hooks_uiscaling but lacks its top/bottom black letterbox strips.
diagnosis.root_cause: Overlay assumed left/right bars only. The portrait 4:3 contain projection leaves non-content top/bottom raster strips without black masking.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: New constexpr BuildMenuBarGeometry composes bounded orientation-specific two-strip vertices. Same cached buffer/DrawPrimitive/state restoration pipeline renders either orientation.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Compile-time header asserts include 4:3 none, 16:9 sides, 21:9 side coordinates, 1200x1600 top/bottom strip coordinates, invalid/oversized source and non-overlapping content.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR game-screen or HMD evidence acquired.
